redfin.remarks: Discover this beautifully maintained condo built in 2001 in a highly desired courtyard complex of only 28 units. Located just a few blocks from Valley Village it features an open floor plan, spacious living and dining areas, two generous bedrooms, and two full bathrooms with modern finishes. Enjoy central air conditioning and heating, attached 2-car garage parking, controlled-access subterranean garage, and low HOA dues. Perfect for first-time buyers, investors, or those seeking low-maintenance Valley Glen living with easy access to freeways, shopping, dining, the NoHo Arts District, Sherman Oaks, and more. Move-in ready with excellent sunlight, views, and proximity to everything LA has to offer. Don't miss this rare opportunity in a secure, well-maintained complex!
